properties.sfomuseum:description: Typewritten letter with handwritten notes and corrections from Harold M. Bixby to S. [Stokely] W. Morgan, dated October 7, 1937, on stationery from Pan American Airways Company, labeled “Personal and Confidential”; includes description of meeting with [William L.] Bond, Lum [Wei-Shing], and P.Y. Wong about the status of CNAC equipment and personnel; includes thought about how to “salvage” Pan American’s efforts in China; mentions Harry [Harold] Sweet, Harry Smith, T.V. Soong, [Oscar] Wilke, Larsen [”Swede” Larson].
